scope: ONLY requested ablation tables A0-A4/S1/S2, not former Stage2 R1/R2/R3 expansion or baseline retraining

single_task_definitions.S1: A0 window-coordinate shape path; only L_shape, no GT/learned anchors in shape generation; inactive event head retained for structural compatibility
single_task_definitions.S2: same stem/TCN/event head; only 0.3*L_anchor; inactive shape head retained, shape scores NA
single_task_definitions.selection_S1: validation shape arithmetic PCC, then -RMSE, then R2, same historical shape-only runner
single_task_definitions.selection_S2: validation independent event macro F1@100ms, then -anchor BCE; no shape selection

training_recipe: same Stage1 config; AdamW 1e-4 wd1e-4; batch16; max100 epochs; patience15; MM drop_lastFalse, CR True; no scheduler/augmentation changes
reuse: 16 A0 originals, six Stage1 A3/A4, three audited MMECG S1 folds1/5/9; all validation-selected
evaluate: After ALL training is done/frozen, one final test inference/export per variant/fold; no test-based selection; old artifacts unchanged

statistics.unit: subject, separately for each dataset; 11 MMECG and30 CR_RVS subjects expected
statistics.PCC: per-subject Fisher-z average across its windows, then arithmetic subject mean; percent for display
statistics.RMSE: arithmetic window mean within subject then equal-subject mean
statistics.R_MAE: frozen R-based one-to-one +/-150ms formal accumulator within subject, arithmetic mean ms
statistics.delta: mean subject PCC(variant)-PCC(A4), percentage points, negative means worse
statistics.bootstrap: 10000 paired-subject resamples, percentile95% CI, local RNG seed42; no seed/window pseudo-replication
statistics.wilcoxon: two-sided signed rank, wilcox zero method, auto method; all-zero differences -> p1
statistics.holm_table1: four A0/A1/A2/A3-vs-A4 PCC comparisons per dataset
statistics.holm_table2: four preplanned per-subject factorial/context PCC contrasts per dataset, separate family
statistics.table3: descriptive only, no additional unregistered significance tests
statistics.star: Holm-adjusted p<0.05; significant inferior variants are also marked, direction shown by delta

coverage: per-subject frozen direct eligible/evaluable ratio; pooled numerator/denominator also exported; matched-only timing errors never hide failures
fallback: all phase-conditioned windows scored, training-only GT fallback never used at test; non-phase paths NA
capacity_caveat: author chose retain unequal head dimensions/checkpoint reuse; report allocated and active parameters; factorial contrasts describe architecture differences, not capacity-controlled causal effects
coupling: forward conditioning with stop-gradient on events/anchors, not bidirectional shape-to-event gradients
